title: Dynamic Form Builder
description: Build a form that allows adding/removing fields and validates each.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

Create a dynamic form where users can add multiple “contact” entries (each with name and email). The form should:
- Allow adding new contact blocks.
- Allow removing any contact block.
- Validate each field: name required, email required and valid format.
- Show validation errors inline (only after the field has been touched).
- Disable the submit button if any validation errors exist.
- On submit, log the array of contacts to the console.

**Bonus**: Implement a global “is form valid” check that also considers all dynamic fields.
hints: Store contacts as an array of objects: `contacts: [{ name: '', email: '' }]`.
Use `v-for` to iterate and bind `v-model` to `contact.name` and `contact.email`.
Create computed properties for validation of each contact (e.g., `contactNameError(index)`) or use a computed that returns an array of errors.
Track touched state per field, perhaps using a separate array or an object with indices.
expectedOutput: A dynamic form with add/remove functionality and real‑time validation.
